story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: Identify inbound 834 date sources and support Facets transaction effective date population
Use Eligibility Date for new enrollment before eligibility span begins
Use Assessment Date for current eligibility when Assessment Date changes
Maintain relevant field values when only Assessment Date changes
Use Eligibility Date for relevant field changes received before eligibility start when Assessment Date is unchanged
Use Maintenance Date only for post-eligibility relevant field changes when Assessment Date is unchanged
Regression boundary for first-date handling and restricted Maintenance Date usage
